name: The Trials of Goodbye
source:
You are the reaper of Death. This is the final person on Earth. You must decide if they go to Heaven, Hell, or Purgatory based on your own actions. You may choose to befriend this person or not. The choice is yours.

[from [url=https://yukimisoft.itch.io/the-trials-of-goodbye]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是死神的收割者。这是地球上最后一个人。你必须通过自己的行动，决定此人将前往天堂、地狱，还是炼狱。你可以选择与对方交朋友，也可以不这么做。一切由你决定。

[摘自[url=https://yukimisoft.itch.io/the-trials-of-goodbye]itch.io[/url]]
